title: Time format
symptom: Users are confused over the format of time when entering bg/carbs/insulin data into xDrip+. The app requires a '.' separator and does not accept ':' or shorthand entries like '14' or '1430'.
fix: The suggestion to allow entering time without special signs (e.g., '14' or '1430') was already implemented in the app.
evidence_quote: Your suggestion is better as there isn't a ":" on the keypad! Actually I think your idea has now been implemented?
